<title>1º Encontro de ex-funcionários da PC Sistemas</title>

<style>
/* Paleta amostrada do convite */
:root{
  --azul-fundo:#17408E;      /* fundo azul do cartaz */
  --azul-fundo-esc:#0F2E69;
  --azul-marca:#1B4E9B;      /* azul do logotipo e dos títulos */
  --azul-escuro:#153B7A;
  --laranja:#E87B23;         /* laranja do logotipo e do "ENCONTRO" */
  --papel:#F2EDE3;
  --papel-som:#E4DACA;       /* sombra/vinco do papel */
  --papel-borda:#E0D5C1;
  --tinta:#2A3340;
  --tinta-fraca:#6B7280;
  --postit-am:#FBE08B;
  --postit-az:#A6D1EC;
  --fita:rgba(226,212,181,.92);
  --erro:#C2341F;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{
  margin:0; padding:26px 12px 64px; min-height:100vh;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1A4697 0%,var(--azul-fundo) 45%,#102E6B 100%);
  font-family:'Montserrat',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--tinta);
}

/* pilha de folhas, como no cartaz */
.palco{max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}
.palco::before,.palco::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:5px;background:#EDE6D9;
  box-shadow:0 12px 30px -18px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
}
.palco::before{transform:rotate(-.9deg) translate(-9px,7px);background:#E8E0D0}
.palco::after{transform:rotate(.7deg) translate(8px,4px);background:#EFE8DB}
.folha{
  position:relative;z-index:2;background:var(--papel);border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 34px 76px -32px rgba(0,0,0,.8);
  padding:clamp(28px,5vw,58px) clamp(18px,4.5vw,58px) 48px;
}
.folha::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(130% 65% at 50% -12%,rgba(255,255,255,.75),transparent 58%)}
.camada{position:relative;z-index:2}

/* rabiscos do cartaz */
.rabisco{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;opacity:.55;z-index:1}
.mancha{top:400px;left:-26px;width:120px;opacity:.35}
.trio{top:250px;left:6px;width:82px}
.seta{top:300px;right:-6px;width:70px}

/* logotipo */
.logo{display:flex;justify-content:center}
.logo img{max-width:230px;height:auto}
.logo svg{width:min(230px,58vw);height:auto}

/* cabeçalho */
.eyebrow{margin:26px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;
  font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(13px,2.6vw,17px);letter-spacing:.42em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--azul-marca)}
.eyebrow::before,.eyebrow::after{content:'';width:36px;height:3px;background:var(--laranja);border-radius:2px}
h1{text-align:center;margin:16px 0 0;line-height:.95;color:var(--azul-marca)}
h1 .l1{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(16px,3.4vw,26px);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
h1 .l2{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(50px,12.5vw,104px);color:var(--laranja);letter-spacing:-.02em;margin:4px 0}
h1 .l3{display:block;font-family:'Caveat',cursive;font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(22px,4.6vw,34px);color:var(--azul-escuro);transform:rotate(-.6deg)}
h1 .l4{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(30px,7vw,56px);letter-spacing:-.01em;margin-top:2px}
.marcas-lat{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px}
.tick{width:11px;height:26px;flex:none}
.risco{display:block;width:min(340px,74%);height:12px;margin:6px auto 0;
  background:radial-gradient(58% 100% at 50% 45%,var(--azul-marca),transparent 74%);opacity:.75;border-radius:99px}
.lead{max-width:46ch;margin:22px auto 0;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(14.5px,2.3vw,17px);color:var(--tinta-fraca);line-height:1.65;font-weight:500}
